title: Decent unit overall
text:
Decent unit overall. Overall a decent slow cooker, however be sure to dry completely as the top ring on mine seemed to rust/corrode a little bit. The only thing I can assume is that it was not fully dried after use (this is the actual cooker, not any piece of the porcelain which cannot rust).
Heats decently well, though the variance between high and low seems to be quite extreme.
